glosses: column, pillar (cylindrical part of a structure, for support)
column (vertical part of a table or grid)

examples.en: The columns were made of marble.

examples.text: Un frisson parcourut ma colonne vertébrale.
examples.en: A shiver ran down my spine.

examples.text: La colonne vertébrale est composée de vingt-quatre os.
examples.en: The spinal column is composed of twenty-four bones.

examples.text: Le geyser propulse une colonne d'eau chaude toutes les deux heures.
examples.en: The geyser sends up a column of hot water every two hours.
